intro.text: Captainlord Meleran Khal, the youngest son of General Khal and Teshav.

items.text: Meleran was born around 1144, after his brothers Halam and Aratin.
Because he and Adolin Kholin are about the same height, Shallan Davar used Lightweaving to disguise Adolin as Meleran several times during Elhokar's mission into Kholinar.

appearance.text: A powerfully built man about Adolin's height, balding by his thirties.
